title: Ant Explorer — explainer overview
notes: Warm gift framing + game overview. Synced 1:1 with screenshot slides in make_demo_videos.sh.

lines.text: This is Ant Explorer — a birthday present for a six-year-old girl who loves ants.
It lives on Star Learner, a homemade game console locked to a few calm, offline worlds. No browser. No store. Just play.
You guide one worker ant through a living leaf-cutter colony — chambers, tunnels, and dozens of busy nestmates.
Tap the ground to walk. Touch a glowing pheromone trail to join a job: forage, garden, nurse, or defend.
Hidden golden stars hold short ant documentaries. Stop beside one, watch, and light it up on the side shelves.
Exploration is the loop. Learning is the reward. Built so she can discover ants at her own pace.
